evaluation: End-to-end classification and quality acceptance, metadata-free article title/body/url inputs; labels follow the confirmed geographic priority. Test split was not used for fitting, policy changes, or threshold selection.
limits: Small source-specific sample, no military cases; category distribution is uneven. This is not a population-wide accuracy estimate. Authored parity controls are not evaluation cases. One film-event development annotation was corrected from culture to entertainment using the original body before the test split was opened.
